system.description:
UNLIVING-MUMMY

Prerequisites Level 6

You remember the architecture of burial, secrecy and ancient warning signs.

Effect: You gain a +2 racial bonus to Search (Perception) and Track (Survival) checks made in tombs, crypts, ruins, burial sites, sealed chambers, and other funerary or ancient constructed spaces.

+2 racial is offered on Search and Track — tick it in tombs, crypts, ruins, burial sites, sealed chambers and other funerary or ancient constructed spaces.

conditionals.label: Tomb Guardian
conditionals.scope: Search and Track in tombs, crypts, ruins, burial sites, sealed chambers and other funerary or ancient constructed spaces
